text:
sasha: heads up — I picked up a minor chart bump for payments-service (chart v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0) and queued a staggered promote across eu/na/apac clusters. noticed the values.yaml merge introduced a replicaCount change and a logging level override that wasn't in release notes :grimacing:

deploy-bot: scheduled promotion: payments-service v2.8.0 -> eu (window 02:00-03:00 UTC), na (03:30-04:30 UTC), apac (05:00-06:00 UTC). canary size=5% -> 25% -> 100%. rollout id=prom-4387654321

sasha: can we hold the na/apac promotes? the eu canary is fine but the values diff shows DB_POOL=20 -> 30 for some tenants (unexpected). I want to validate connection pool behavior first.

nina: ACK, please hold. if deploy-bot already started na, we should pause it. how to pause?

deploy-bot: promote pipeline status: eu=running(canary), na=queued, apac=queued. to pause queued stages run: `curl -X POST $DEPLOY_BOT/api/v1/promotes/prom-4387654321/pause` or use Console -> Releases -> prom-4387654321 -> Pause

omar: strong +1 to pausing. also recommend adding a post-canary smoke that runs `SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE tenant = 'edge'` to catch pool saturation. if the pool change landed accidentally we should pin values back to replicaCount and DB_POOL from v2.7.1 for affected tenants.

sasha: exact plan: 1) pause na/apac (deploy-bot), 2) run smoke in eu canary, 3) if smoke flaky -> rollback eu and revert values to v2.7.1 for tenant list, 4) update release notes and tag the PR as urgent.

ryan: who owns release notes update? I can take it but need the diff to be explicit (what changed in values + why). also ping support to prepare for potential tenant tickets.

nina: I will run the EU smoke in 10m and post results here. if failing, I'll trigger `helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace payments` and mark the release pinned to 2.7.1 until we triage.

sasha: nina, ping me the smoke output. if rollback happens, let's add a deploy-blocker label on the PR and add a one-line summary for the incident doc.

omar: small note: the values merge script appended a top-level `logging.level: debug` under an indented block which could overflow logs for older nodes. if we see log spike that's also grounds to rollback.

deploy-bot: hold applied to promotion prom-4387654321: na, apac queued stages paused by request of sasha. eu canary continuing.

nina: EU smoke: 200/200 requests ok, DB_conn avg=12ms, no saturation observed. logging spikes minimal.

sasha: good. nina, proceed to ramp to 25% in eu, but keep na/apac paused. we'll run tenant-specific load for the next 30m. I'll update release notes with values diff and the temporary hold. ry an, please notify support.

ryan: notified support, added a note in Slack #support-ops and created a support ticket INC-2024-138. will update with any customer reports.

sasha: action items captured: - nina: monitor eu ramp + smoke (next 30m) - nina/sasha: if any DB_conn >50ms or error rate >0.5% -> helm rollback eu -> pin release to 2.7.1 - ryan: release notes update + support ticket - omar: prepare quick revert values patch and a one-click helm command gist

deploy-bot: promote prom-4387654321 status: eu=ramped to 25% canary, na=paused, apac=paused. will not auto-unpause.

sasha: thanks. leaving this thread open for the next 45m for any regressions. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
